name: 91775 · San Gabriel, CA
findings: ZIP 91775 (San Gabriel) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91775 (San Gabriel) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91775 (San Gabriel) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
